name: Tool-neutral root rules + thin adapters
rule: AGENTS.md holds the rules; tool files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot) only point to it; stubs are generated from a neutral tool vocabulary

name: Domain-area model
rule: each area has INDEX, PIPELINES, RULES, MEMORY, KNOWLEDGE and TICKETS; code stays in the project, knowledge in its mirror

name: Mechanical placement
rule: a path formula plus a decision table decide where every file goes; create the standard folder instead of asking

name: Index is a map, history is a changelog
rule: indexes are generated and never hand-edited, with a size budget; history goes to a changelog

name: Registry-vs-reality validator
rule: a registry row that contradicts the disk is a bug; fail loudly on drift

name: Scope census + SUPERSEDED
rule: every doc carries a scope line (method, case or mixed); nothing is deleted, it gets a pointer

name: Graph as an instrument
rule: query the code graph before reading code; stamp its freshness; validate hub nodes against a known truth; resolve names within the corpus; no LLM labelling of communities

name: Open-question onboarding
rule: one area knowledge file with a STATUS section; the smoke test is a plain question answered from the base

name: Faithful legacy assessment
rule: photography, not renovation; file:line on every fact; index before reading in large repositories

name: Legacy docs are input, never truth
rule: a legacy claim stays a hypothesis until code confirms it; an owner-verified document is still a hypothesis

name: Agent reading + deterministic re-check
rule: agents photograph, a script or the graph re-verifies; the conductor renumbers colliding ids with a mapping table; the sub-agent brief is kept as a relaunch template

name: Negative knowledge
rule: every wave records what not to do and the limits it accepted

name: Official-source archive
rule: archive each norm with a hash and a text copy; close every check as confirms, adjusts, overturns or not official, with page and line; the document format is itself an error source

name: Migration direction
rule: the retiring system adapts, never the target; business keys re-index, else the target generates the id and returns it to the legacy; legacy state is a mirror event; a not-synced dependency error makes ordering self-healing

name: Rules as data
rule: business rules live in a structured catalog and documents are generated from it; the catalog is an index to choose from, not a seed to implement whole

name: Inverse process + sibling diff
rule: map the inverse process before changing domain; document a sibling process as a difference table

name: Draft to rounds to closed prompt
rule: organise the draft as it is, with warning marks and a residue sweep; decision ids are cited in the code

name: Requirements pipeline
rule: functional, non-functional and business rules, Given-When-Then and positive, negative, boundary and regression scenarios, from the document and without reading code

name: Validation vs message vs decision
rule: validation judges, a message communicates, a decision returns a typed choice; one error envelope; the catalog generates the table

name: Conceptual guardian
rule: scale-model test and triggering fact; occupied-words table; presence vs act; third-party voice vs own effect; a decision with a condition becomes a delivery check

name: Decision rounds
rule: step 0 checks recorded decisions and splits fact vs intent; evidence, closed options and one recommendation; divergence recorded in the owner's words

name: Namespaced decision ids + generated index
rule: KEY#N where a namespace is a project or a front; reserved ranges for parallel sessions; never renumber; citation check

name: Assumption ledger + release word
rule: proceed on the recommendation as an assumption to ratify; nothing is committed, published, seeded or deployed without the owner's release word

name: Business-rule stay files
rule: one file per rule with an append-only authorised and denied history; agents stop on a denied row at plan, review and close

name: People are not roles
rule: never infer a role from a tracker field

name: Front prompt as a living spec
rule: header, facts, questions, decisions, waves, execution log and resume block, with a size budget: executed waves move to annexes

name: Pipeline gate
rule: no fix design on a process nobody has mapped

name: Code gate + single pass
rule: plan, spec or red test first; a literal STOP; the go is logged; each file written once; modes plan, spec and test

name: Prepare-only for the irreversible
rule: the agent prepares commit, merge, deploy and tracker writes and the human executes; the harness ask-list is the executable twin; database read-only; the agent never types passwords

name: Session save and resume
rule: record branch and hashes, verified state, remaining steps, next free ids and a short paste-ready prompt; checkpoints stage only the front's own hunks

name: Worktree per front
rule: the live tree is production; green certifies a combination of checkouts; the last to reach main writes the adapter

name: Ownership partition
rule: another group's code is read by name only; a need becomes a request in that group's document

name: Disposable proof + cutover window
rule: prove seeds and schema in a throwaway copy (count, rerun idempotent, an impossible variant fails loud); natural keys; a runbook with entry and abort criteria rehearsed with outbound hosts blocked

name: Anti-patch
rule: silencing a crash or a warning is a finding, not a fix

name: Cross-version drift + pipeline diff
rule: compare the unit and its pipelines across active versions before planning; the diff reads docs and stops when one is missing

name: Shared intake
rule: reuse this week's dossier and state the source; filter tracker noise; QA revert feedback first; attachments mined to text

name: Test plan mandatory
rule: red first with the log kept; exempt is a written line with a reason and waives only the new test

name: Baseline-diff gate
rule: block only new failures; record pre-existing ones; not-run-here is not a failure; rollout starts warn-only

name: Delivery gates
rule: Socratic score of at least 0.70; adversarial review with no high or critical finding; each finding becomes a permanent probe; the owner walks the real app

name: Fences
rule: for an invariant that drifts silently: one source list, a static scan, a read-only live test, a boot alarm, a publish script that stops and a refusal at the API

name: Browser verification
rule: one engine-agnostic spec; PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or MANUAL with literal values; login is always human; never assert text you typed

name: Result review
rule: review the result, never one revision alone; open, acknowledged and resolved handshake; a finding needs file:line and a failure scenario

name: Exit tests and dry runs
rule: prove a process on a real item before calling it done

name: Dependency-levelled incremental tests
rule: test table by table in dependency levels; stop at the first error; a reset needs approval

name: Single closing step + close script
rule: one closer writes the tracker text, the memory log and the card decision, then runs the mechanical checks

name: Retention chain
rule: retain test, destination, index, rules, memory and SUPERSEDED marks, all in the same task

name: Episodic claims + before/after memory
rule: logs carry typed claims (fact, inference or hypothesis with confidence and evidence) and a consolidated flag; query memory before acting and compare after

name: Consolidation cycles
rule: at five unconsolidated logs: survivors, chains, dead ends and contradictions; never delete

name: Atomic cards
rule: one rule per file, only from facts at 0.8 or more; strengthen instead of duplicating; VCS-neutral provenance

name: Derived memory index
rule: a full-text SQLite index rebuilt from the markdown, never the source of record

name: Product journal + lesson deadline
rule: one insight per line, append-only; a method lesson reaches the kit within one working session; the master prompt improves itself

name: Git security pack
rule: versioning hygiene and secrets protection; assume a hard-coded credential until proven otherwise

name: Sensitive-data report
rule: type, location, line and risk plus an action plan; never the secret value

name: Encoding guard
rule: configurable charset policy; post-edit and pre-commit hook; charset-only hunks detected

name: Revert guard
rule: warn when a local change removes recently committed lines

name: MCP configuration per environment
rule: the model is versioned and secret-free; the activation is local and never versioned; merge only the server list, after a backup

name: Environment setup agent
rule: profiles; each step checks first and runs only what is missing; network commands are shown before they run

name: Feedback analyst
rule: mines the logs and proposes agent edits; a human approves

name: Evaluate the harness
rule: trace per session, composite score, Pareto front; promote or reject by data

name: Honesty audit
rule: every status says operating or design; no silent upgrades

name: Adoption-first merge
rule: retire only with a counterpart; migrate by script with a dry run; never fix content during a migration

name: Agent vs skill authoring guide
rule: an agent holds judgment, a skill a fixed procedure; required sections; under 500 lines

name: Abstraction ladder
rule: one manifest, audience tiers by depth, fixed statuses; every box links a real document

name: Ecosystem map curator
rule: the spec is the source and the HTML is disposable; mode A generator vs mode B extension of an approved page; diagram before prose; back-links; verify parity before claiming it

name: Abstraction-tree graph
rule: one machine-readable graph of the whole tree for agents to navigate; never hand-edited

name: Generated agents and skills catalog
rule: regenerated from the real files; flags skills that exist only in a local tool folder

name: Settings mapper
rule: config properties, environment or INI keys, database flags and compile-time flags; reachability checked; registry with status and areas

name: Pipeline builder
rule: a pipeline is a sequence triggered by settings; ask which are active; one document per area and condition; collision analysis; read the merged layer

name: Single docs writer
rule: one agent writes unit docs; the template comes from the unit type; required sections validated; one table per data document; never speculate

name: Build analyst
rule: builds registered as data with the output outside the tree; a risky compiler warning is a finding with file:line

name: Local working-folder importer
rule: backup gate; the first folder is supervised; dedup, curate, version only that folder and delete the local copy only after it landed

name: Standard governance block
rule: every agent ends with the same mandatory block: scope line, guardian, decision rounds, retention chain and prepare-only

name: Mold factory
rule: two hand-written pieces become molds; agents generate the rest from the mold, the real schema and non-negotiable rules

name: Reversible install journal
rule: every machine change is one JSON line; uninstall reverses them newest first; install runs only on explicit request

name: Commit watcher + proposal agent
rule: classify each revision by path; the first claim wins; the script runs the suite; the agent writes only its proposal folder; a human promotes

name: Test-evidence integrity
rule: read the tests-found count and reconcile it; red is an assertion, not a compile error; expected values come from reading the code; a mutation flip is the minimum proof

name: Coverage completion gate
rule: the integrating agent owns the shared coverage lists; the workers' green does not discharge it

name: Change packaging
rule: every new file is added to version control when it is created; nothing unversioned at hand-over; fix and tests in two commits

name: Isolated-diff backport
rule: one comparison folder per revision; the diff from the matching line; validate each file before the next; never copy a whole file across lines

name: Revision forensics
rule: never judge one revision alone; classify the overlaps; name the culprit revision

name: Divergence-point debugging
rule: symptom, recall, state map and first diverging statement; the fix goes there

name: Path integrity + contract first
rule: never cite a symbol you have not read; a cross-tier change is done only when every tier resolves

name: Shared-state analysis
rule: writer matrix, per-environment gate matrix and crossing-failure history; an unknown cell says unknown

name: Override-parity reading
rule: a step that lands on an overridden method quotes the override, the base and the predecessor conditions

name: Review pack + answer round-trip
rule: the pack removes discovery from the meeting; questions are published after the owner confirms them; answers are quoted, classified and registered

name: Tenant-isolation guard
rule: closing fails when the change set touches another tenant's project

name: Project inventory validator
rule: project roots and registry rows checked both ways; a document's project front matter matches its folder; a dated switch moves a warning to a failure

name: Retired-location guard
rule: normative files must not point at retired locations, in any spelling

name: Frozen-source retirement gate
rule: snapshot the old store, report drift with an old-to-new map, retire it at zero drift or after a human ruling on each item

name: Toolchain pinning
rule: exact pins or vendored source; a version bump is a decision; never latest; never run a tool's init at the base root

name: Per-agent tool allow-list
rule: each persona declares its tools so that a client's tool cap cannot drop the memory tools

name: Deliverable gate
rule: the artifact language is fixed; never the root folder; the markdown is the record and binaries are exports beside it

name: Link and provenance hygiene
rule: links only to markdown; source files as plain text; every derived document carries the revision of its source

name: Read-only data probe
rule: the query runner refuses write keywords and DDL without an explicit flag, proves the session read-only by a write the database refuses, and caps the rows; no stored credential

name: Case-neutral AI layer
rule: no client names in agents or skills; client specifics sit behind a pointer to a per-client notes file

name: Weekly evidence report
rule: worked and handed over is what counts; filter by author; date by the change date
